assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (diagnosis I47.1).
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9).
Prolonged ambulatory monitoring via mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is indicated.
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the recurrent palpitations and dizziness in the context of the patient's transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
